source_text:
9.17 Γινώσκεται Κύριος κρίματα ποιῶν. Εστιν
ο τε καὶ ἐκ τῶν κριμάτων ποδη γούμενος ὁ α νθρωπος ἐπιγινώσκει τὸν Κύριον.
pass_a_gloss: Is-known Lord judgments making. There-is when also out-of the judgments being-guided the man comes-to-know the Lord.
pass_b_english: “The Lord is known as he makes judgments” (Psalm 9:17).
There is a time when man, guided also from the judgments, comes to know the Lord.

choices.why: ποδηγέω = lead by the foot/guide. Not ‘kicked’ or ‘footed from judgments’.

anf_compare.notes: ANF lacks this Greek catena as reading English.
